identificationModule.briefTitle: HB1801 Combined Treatment of HER2-positive Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of HB1801 Combination Therapy as First-line Treatment in HER2-positive Unresectable Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer

leadSponsor.name: CSPC ZhongQi Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is designed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of HB1801 combination therapy as first-line treatment in HER2-positive unresectable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: This is an open-label, multi-center, randomized, Phase II clinical study.

armGroups.label: Cohort 1：Combination of HB1801, Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab
armGroups.description: HB1801: per protocol; Trastuzumab: 8mg/kg loading dose and then 6mg/kg, Q3W; Pertuzumab: 840mg loading dose and then 420mg, Q3W

armGroups.label: Cohort 2：Combination of Docetaxel, Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab
armGroups.description: Docetaxel：75mg/m\^2 ，Q3W Trastuzumab: 8mg/kg loading dose and then 6mg/kg, Q3W; Pertuzumab: 840mg loading dose and then 420mg, Q3W
